scope: Engine-first phased swarm implementation plan through to goal (excluding asset production). Covers Clean-Room & Monolith Remediation, Source-Preserving Corpus & Cohort Estimation (C1-C5), Whole-Biosphere & Earth/Space Solvers (BIO/EAS), Unified Native/WASM Poet & Aether Host (AR/PA), and Selective HMC Streaming, Derivation Compiler & Native 193-Deliverable Completion Gate (BS-30..50 / ENG-11..12).

coordination_protocol.shared_mutation_owner: Coordinator exclusively owns root Cargo.toml, shared lib.rs/mod.rs registration, and all serial Cargo check/test invocations.
worker_rules: Workers may only create or modify files listed in their job's disjoint_owned_files.
Workers must never run cargo build/check/test concurrently; all compilation and test execution is performed serially by the Coordinator at the Phase Gate.
Every new or modified .rs implementation file must remain strictly under 500 lines; directory-backed mod.rs files only route modules and re-export public APIs.

Tier-1 hot paths (NQuin evaluators, query kernels, GPU/WASM ABI) must be 100% zero-heap (caller-supplied &mut [T] slices and fixed stack arrays). Tier-2 cold construction must use bounded caller budgets and fail closed on exhaustion.

External MIT *-craft repositories are strictly read-only architectural specifications. Never copy external code into qualiaDB; implement clean-room domain capabilities inside poet while preserving required notices.

flash_lite.use_when: Read-only file inventories, SHA-256 hash pinning, or line-count/symbol checks.
flash_lite.do_not_use_for: Writing Rust solver logic, API design, or security/permission gates.

flash.use_when: Bounded module decomposition (<500 lines), Cargo feature-gate wiring, deterministic parser/mapper field updates with explicit specs, fail-closed CLI guards, and mechanical UI/IntentBus command routing.
flash.do_not_use_for: Complex numerical solvers, symbolic logic compilers, GPU device sharing, or final gate acceptance.

pro.use_when: Zero-heap statistical/cohort estimation kernels, N3 defeasible/deontic logic compilation, multi-junction SDF & SKL1 skeletal IK/contact solvers, Etalon/Aether/PortalGpu device sharing, selective HMC byte-range streaming, master-to-profile derivation compilers, and Independent Phase Gate Auditing.
pro.do_not_use_for: Trivial file splits or boilerplate wiring that flash handles at a fraction of the token cost.

mandatory_work_output_verification.rule: No worker output is accepted on self-report. Every phase concludes with (1) Coordinator serial cargo check/test execution and (2) an Independent Phase Gate Auditor (pro tier) inspecting every changed file against line-count, zero-heap, clean-room provenance, negative-test coverage, and exact specification compliance.
mandatory_work_output_verification.on_failure: Gate Auditor rejects the specific job_id with exact file/line findings; the rejected job is remediated and re-audited before the phase gate can pass.
